content.cast.opening-night.agathe.0.bark.0: 一条长着自己尾巴的龙。想象一下。
content.cast.opening-night.agathe.0.bark.1: 退后。我要开嗓，练练吼声。
content.cast.opening-night.agathe.1.bark.1: 退后。我要开嗓，练练吼声。
content.cast.opening-night.elin.0.bark.0: 一手宽就九百根线。我数了。两遍。
content.cast.opening-night.elin.0.bark.1: 红配金。等挂起来你就知道了。
content.cast.opening-night.oskar.0.bark.1: 同一个烤炉，同一个炉门。跟每年一样。
content.cast.opening-night.oskar.1.bark.0: 那是个面包。她说的。我敲了敲。都响了。
content.cast.opening-night.oskar.1.bark.1: 四分钟。我烤了四十年面包了。
content.cast.opening-night.runa.0.bark.0: 炉门装回去了。我先把它擦亮了。
content.cast.opening-night.runa.0.bark.1: 锻炉烤得更好。你自己说的。我听见了。
content.cast.opening-night.runa.1.bark.1: 外皮像马蹄铁。这样就是烤好了。
content.cast.opening-night.sanna.0.bark.0: 两百张脸。我只看我要看的那几张。
content.cast.opening-night.sanna.0.bark.1: 每句台词我都记得。你考我一句。不，别考。
content.cast.opening-night.vidar.0.bark.0: 我提议消防通道保持畅通。
content.cast.the-chorus.oskar.0.bark.1: 同一个烤炉，同一个炉门。跟每年一样。
content.cast.the-chorus.oskar.1.bark.0: 那是个面包。她说的。我敲了敲。都响了。
content.cast.the-chorus.oskar.1.bark.1: 四分钟。我烤了四十年面包了。
content.cast.the-chorus.runa.0.bark.0: 炉门装回去了。我先把它擦亮了。
content.cast.the-chorus.runa.0.bark.1: 锻炉烤得更好。你自己说的。我听见了。
content.cast.the-chorus.runa.1.bark.1: 外皮像马蹄铁。这样就是烤好了。
content.cast.the-curtain.fenna.1.bark.0: 四个声音又聚齐了。拉呀！
content.cast.the-curtain.kettil.1.bark.0: 我的木桶在后头。别朝它看。
content.cast.the-founder.bernt.0.bark.0: 城堡太安静了。我发觉我不喜欢。
content.cast.the-founder.bernt.0.bark.1: 我烧了壶水，却没有客人。习惯而已。
content.cast.the-loaf.dumpling.0.bark.0: 团子在窗边低哼，望着下面吵闹的镇子。
content.cast.the-loaf.inga.0.bark.0: 她自个儿沿小路下去了。我一路都看着。
content.cast.the-loaf.inga.0.bark.1: 灯芯剪好了。我会在廊台看戏。
content.cast.the-loaf.runa.1.bark.0: 告诉奥斯卡，炉门还热着。我把它擦亮了。
content.cast.the-loaf.sanna.0.bark.0: 我来了。我到了广场。我还没跑掉。
content.cast.the-loaf.sanna.0.bark.1: “我已渡过了冰冷的海——”看吧？很简单。
content.cast.the-troupe.agathe.0.bark.0: 如果赫达打发你们来，有茶。
content.cast.the-troupe.bernt.0.bark.0: 阿加特夫人现在会客。她向来会客。
content.cast.the-troupe.bernt.0.bark.1: 恶魂不用喂。已经喂过了。
content.cast.the-troupe.elin.0.bark.0: 一手宽有九百根线。我数过。两遍。
content.cast.the-troupe.elin.0.bark.1: 红色和金色。等挂起来你就知道了。
content.cast.the-troupe.fenna.0.bark.0: 拉呀，拉呀——人都去哪儿了？
content.cast.the-troupe.fenna.0.bark.1: 一个人的合唱就是独唱。我不唱独唱。
content.cast.the-troupe.fenna.1.bark.0: 拉呀，拉呀——人都去哪儿了？
content.cast.the-troupe.fenna.1.bark.1: 一个人的合唱就是独唱。我不唱独唱。
content.cast.the-troupe.inga.0.bark.1: 我侄女在里面。从中午就在了。
content.cast.the-troupe.mari.0.bark.1: 海鸥讨厌我的和声。海鸥没品味。哈！
content.cast.the-troupe.mari.1.bark.1: 海鸥讨厌我的和声。海鸥没品味。哈！
content.cast.the-troupe.oskar.0.bark.0: 面包不顶嘴。所以我喜欢它。
content.cast.the-troupe.oskar.0.bark.1: 面粉、蜂蜜、葛缕子。还有一扇门。总有一天。
content.cast.the-troupe.runa.0.bark.0: 凯尔德比最好的门，那扇。我修的。
content.cast.the-troupe.runa.0.bark.1: 铁匠炉烤得更好。问谁都行。问我。
content.cast.the-troupe.sanna.0.bark.0: “我渡过了寒冷的海——”不对。再来。
content.cast.the-troupe.sverre.0.bark.1: 船壳、歌和晚饭，三样都是同一个造法。
content.cast.the-troupe.sverre.1.bark.1: 船壳、歌和晚饭，三样都是同一个造法。
content.cast.the-troupe.vidar.0.bark.0: 我提议：消防通道保持畅通。
content.cast.the-troupe.vidar.0.bark.1: 附则第九条。四步宽。年年如此。
content.class.lead.blurb: 没人肯演主角时，他顶上。随身带一顶羽饰帽和路上吃的面包。
content.class.lead.kit.0.name: 羽饰帽
content.class.lead.name: 主角
content.class.musician.blurb: 为剧团奏响上下场。带一支号角和路上吃的面包。
content.class.musician.kit.0.name: 剧团号角
content.class.musician.name: 乐师
content.class.prompter.blurb: 记得所有人的台词，悄悄提词。带一本提词本和路上吃的面包。
content.class.prompter.kit.0.name: 提词本
content.class.prompter.name: 提词人
content.class.stagehand.blurb: 搬动别人搬不动的东西。带一盏舞台提灯和路上吃的面包。
content.class.stagehand.kit.0.name: 舞台提灯
content.class.stagehand.name: 剧务
content.containers.decoration_notice: 镇上的桶、板条箱和橱柜都装着主人的东西：只许看，不许开。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-dumpling.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-dumpling.text: 我的恶魂，就是天花板上那个白色大家伙。他在城堡里飘来飘去，嗡嗡叫。我走到哪儿他跟到哪儿，这很好；跟到浴室，就不好了。只要有人想起问他一句，他二话不说就会跟我下到广场去。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-going.text: 我提早下来，是要趁孩子们还精神的时候吓吓他们。告诉赫达，龙到了。告诉她，我也说了我怕。她会爱听的。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-jackdaw.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-jackdaw.text: 她三月从窗户飞进来，挑了龙尾巴，因为那儿绿、暖和，还编满了柳条。很会挑。她孵着四个蛋。我还没给它们起名字。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-old.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-old.text: 龙本来就老，这正是龙的意义所在。可龙得从山上下来，我不确定我的膝盖同不同意。从春天起我就怕这个了。好了，我说出来了，你可以告诉赫达，她会叫起来的。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.0.label: 太老了？
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.1.label: 寒鸦？
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.2.label: 团子是谁？
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.3.label: 把巢挪走
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.3.tooltip: 把鸟巢连同蛋一起搬到院子里的箱子里，阿加特·霍尔姆夫人就能穿上整套戏服。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.4.label: 团子当尾巴
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.4.tooltip: 鸟巢就留在原处。团子裹着帆布，飘在她身后，他就是尾巴。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.text: 赫达派你来的。她当然会。坐吧，有茶。麻烦是这样：一只寒鸦在龙的尾巴里筑了巢，还下了蛋，我可不想在演戏当天下午把邻居从她家里赶出去。还有一件麻烦事：我七十八了，我怕是太老了，当不了龙，而且我可不愿在全镇人面前弄清这一点。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-door.opt.0.label: 她还好吗？
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-door.opt.1.label: 带我们见她
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-door.opt.1.tooltip: 请贝恩特带你去见阿加特·霍尔姆夫人。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-door.text: 来客。通报：数位陌生人，上气不接下气，候在阿加特·霍尔姆夫人门前。我是贝恩特，她的管家。你们是为龙而来的。人人都是为龙而来的。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-well.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-well.text: 她好得很。她认定自己太老了，一只寒鸦则认定那身戏服是座房子。我说不准她更烦哪一桩。她会自己告诉你们的。她对谁都什么都说。
content.dlg.dumpling.dumpling-hum.text: 团子冲你低低地、满足地哼着，慢慢转身，好让你把它整个看个够。
content.dlg.dumpling.dumpling-tail.text: 团子从头到尾裹着帆布，朝你哼着。他以前从没当过尾巴。他好像觉得干得还不错。
content.dlg.elin.elin-loom.opt.0.label: 为什么不行？
content.dlg.elin.elin-loom.opt.1.label: 去找维达尔
content.dlg.elin.elin-loom.opt.1.tooltip: 去主街的公会大厅，找维达尔·福斯谈谈幕布的事。
content.dlg.elin.elin-loom.text: 你们是剧团？那你们能帮我挂幕布。我给这出戏新织了一块：红底，金线织出龙和始祖的船，手工编了九百根线。我想今晚把它挂在广场上。公会大厅的维达尔·福斯说不行。
content.dlg.elin.elin-news.opt.0.label: 他说得对
content.dlg.elin.elin-news.opt.0.tooltip: 告诉埃琳把幕布挂在舞台后面三步远的地方，消防通道就空出来了。
content.dlg.elin.elin-news.text: 怎么样？他又说不吗？他连说不都说得好听。
content.dlg.elin.elin-why.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.elin.elin-why.text: 他说会挡住消防通道。他话多着呢。他通常都对，这最让人受不了。
content.dlg.fenna.fenna-chorus.opt.0.label: 他们在哪儿？
content.dlg.fenna.fenna-chorus.opt.1.label: 我们去找他们
content.dlg.fenna.fenna-chorus.opt.1.tooltip: 找到凯蒂尔、玛丽和斯韦雷，带他们回到合唱队。
content.dlg.fenna.fenna-chorus.text: 拉呀，拉呀——哦，你好。我领的是戏里渡海那场的水手号子合唱，我的合唱队员都不见了。凯蒂尔是我们的箍桶匠，玛丽管渔网棚，斯韦雷是造船匠：三副嗓子，都在镇上某处，就是不在我这儿。
content.dlg.fenna.fenna-where.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.fenna.fenna-where.text: 凯蒂尔在他的箍桶铺，主街往下走一点。他唱歌，但只肯在没人看见的地方唱。玛丽在街尾附近的渔网棚，她唱高音。斯韦雷在侧巷的船匠棚里。你好好请他，叫他的名字，他就会唱。他这人很讲究。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-agathe.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-agathe.text: 她演龙演了三十年了。她是我最老的朋友，吼起来像山崩。要是她说她不来，那一定有原因，而且不会是她打发人来说的那个原因。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.opt.0.label: 阿加特女士？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.opt.1.label: 桑娜？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.opt.2.label: 奥斯卡和鲁娜？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.opt.3.label: 回去干活。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.text: 还在这儿？太阳可不等人。龙在城堡那边，创镇者在灯塔那边，那个面包在面包房和铁匠铺之间某处。广场这边我来守着。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-legend.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-legend.text: 凯尔德比的建镇故事。一个渔家女子，也就是创镇者，驾船驶进海湾。山上的龙说，她可以留下，只要每年给它带一个面包。她烤出第一个山面包，龙吃了，成为镇子的朋友，然后大家都去了酒馆。酒馆不在戏里。但这是真的。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-loaf.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-loaf.text: 他们从九岁吵到现在。鲁娜修好了奥斯卡的炉门，现在攥着不还，要等他承认一件他死也不会承认的事。跟面包有关。但主要是面子。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-missing.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-missing.text: 龙在城堡那边，从广场沿长路走到顶就是。灯塔在海岬上：沿主街向下，走到底附近的小路，再走悬崖小径。面包房就在广场下面，铁匠铺在主街半路，铁砧招牌下面。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-not-troupe.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-not-troupe.text: 你们当然就是剧团。你们在一个下午，手头没事，走进我的广场。这就是剧团。现在，你们是打算站在那儿，还是来帮忙？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-not-yet.text: 那就去把他们找来！我来拖住太阳。我拖不住，但我可以瞪着它。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-places.opt.0.label: 开演！
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-places.opt.1.label: 还没。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-places.text: 各就各位！各就各位，大家。长椅快坐满了，太阳也在下山。只要这广场上有了龙、创镇者和面包，我就拉开幕。有了吗？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-sanna.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-sanna.text: 桑娜在码头上补网，创镇者的每句台词她都烂熟。她能对着海鸥说得一字不差。面对人就是另一回事了。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.0.label: 我们不是剧团。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.1.label: 演什么？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.2.label: 去哪儿？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.3.label: 交给我们。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.3.tooltip: 交给我们：日落之前，龙、创镇者和面包都会到齐。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.text: 你们可算来了：剧团！我是赫达·布拉斯克。我经营着钟声酒馆，每年日落时分，我都在这广场上导演创镇者之剧。而今天正是演出日。我们有舞台。但我们没有龙，没有创镇者，也没有面包。阿加特女士不肯从城堡下来。补网工桑娜跑去了她姑妈的灯塔。面包师奥斯卡烤不了面包，因为铁匠鲁娜扣着他的炉门。
content.dlg.hedda.play-curtain-call.opt.0.label: 谢幕。
content.dlg.hedda.play-curtain-call.opt.0.toolti: 走到全镇人面前，鞠躬致谢。
content.dlg.hedda.play-curtain-call.text: 赫达走到舞台前方，对着长椅上的观众，也对着你说道：“凯尔德比，我要坦白一件事。我请的剧团根本没来。这些人不是演员。他们一走上我的广场，我就知道了，但我什么也没说，因为他们答应了。给他们鼓鼓掌吧。”
content.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-dumpling.text: 阿加特女士大步上台，身后跟着裹在帆布里的团子，飘进来当尾巴。前排的孩子们高兴得尖叫。阿加特女士一声咆哮，团子从没听过她咆哮，于是哼得更响。
content.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-nest.opt.0.label: 继续演出。
content.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-nest.text: 阿加特女士穿着整套戏服上台，尾巴什么的都有，咆哮起来像山崩。城堡院子里，在你钉好的箱子里，一只寒鸦睡过了整场咆哮。
content.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-roar.opt.0.label: 继续演出。
content.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-roar.text: 你从侧幕吼了一声。阿加特女士转身，用两倍的音量吼了回来，广场上为这场较量鼓起掌来，龙这才想起还在演戏。
content.dlg.hedda.play-dragon.opt.0.label: 让龙上场
content.dlg.hedda.play-dragon.opt.1.label: 让龙上场
content.dlg.hedda.play-dragon.opt.2.label: 幕后吼叫
content.dlg.hedda.play-dragon.text: 铁皮上一阵雷鸣。舞台边的灯笼闪烁起来。龙从山上下来了。
content.dlg.hedda.play-founder-buoys.opt.0.label: 继续演出。
content.dlg.hedda.play-founder-buoys.text: 桑娜找到了第一排：六个上了漆的浮标，咧嘴笑着坐在长椅上。她对它们说话，说得那样好，以至于广场上的人都忘了她刚才还开不了口。‘我渡过了寒冷的大海，’她对浮标们说，‘我要留下来。’
content.dlg.hedda.play-founder-song.opt.0.label: 开演吧
content.dlg.hedda.play-founder-song.text: 桑娜的手开始织补一张并不存在的网，念白变成了码头上每个织网人都熟的劳动号子。唱到第二段，长凳上的渔妇也跟着唱了起来。
content.dlg.hedda.play-founder-whisper.text: 你在侧幕边低声念出台词。桑娜跟着你念，又响又清楚，然后下一句不用你带，自己就接上了。“我渡过了寒冷的大海，我要留在这里。”
content.dlg.hedda.play-founder.opt.0.label: 指指浮标
content.dlg.hedda.play-founder.opt.1.label: 哼劳动号子
content.dlg.hedda.play-founder.opt.2.label: 低声提词
content.dlg.hedda.play-founder.text: 幕布升起，露出画出来的大海。桑娜扮演开基先祖走出来，张开嘴，看见两百张面孔，停住了。整个广场都在等。她看着你。
content.dlg.hedda.play-loaf-forge.opt.0.label: 谢幕
content.dlg.hedda.play-loaf-forge.text: 鲁娜端着山面包上场，黑得像马蹄铁，分量却重一倍。龙咬下去，龙牙没咬动。阿加特夫人从旁边再试一次。第三排有人笑，接着所有人都笑了，戏就停在那儿，差一场没演完。
content.dlg.hedda.play-loaf-oven.opt.0.label: 谢幕
content.dlg.hedda.play-loaf-oven.text: 奥斯卡双手端着山面包上场，金灿灿的，是用他自己的烤炉、他自己的炉门烤出来的。龙咬了一口，又咬一口，然后，跟每回排练都不一样，把整条面包全吃了。龙满嘴面包地说：“朋友们。”这就是戏的结尾。
content.dlg.hedda.play-loaf.opt.0.label: 端上面包
content.dlg.hedda.play-loaf.opt.1.label: 端上面包
content.dlg.hedda.play-loaf.text: “把我的面包拿来！”龙吼道。开基先祖转向侧幕，面包师端着山面包上场。
content.dlg.inga.inga-buoys.opt.0.label: 回去
content.dlg.inga.inga-buoys.text: 六个，上面画着脸。她说，只要那东西不朝她回望，她就能念出台词。她没说错。我亲耳听过，一字不差。
content.dlg.inga.inga-door.opt.0.label: 浮标？
content.dlg.inga.inga-door.opt.1.label: 能见见她吗？
content.dlg.inga.inga-door.text: 你是赫达那边来的吧。桑娜和我在这里。从中午起就待在这儿，跟浮标说话。
content.dlg.inga.inga-go-on.text: 去吧。轻一点。她比自己以为的更勇敢。别说是我说的。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-cooper.opt.0.label: 闭上眼睛？
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-cooper.opt.1.label: 在桶里唱
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-cooper.opt.1.tooltip: 在舞台后面的一只桶里唱，没人能看见你。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-cooper.text: 敲敲木头。芬娜派你来的。我会唱。但如果有人看着我，我就唱不出来。我试过。声音会掉进靴子里。敲敲木头。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-eyes.opt.0.label: 回去
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-eyes.text: 那我就看不见他们了，可他们还是看得见我。要紧的正是这一半。敲敲木头。
content.dlg.mari.mari-high.opt.0.label: 回去
content.dlg.mari.mari-high.text: 第三段最高音。别人都上不去。凯蒂尔试着唱过一回，他家的猫都离家出走了。哈哈！
content.dlg.mari.mari-loft.opt.0.label: 高音部分？
content.dlg.mari.mari-loft.opt.1.label: 来一起唱
content.dlg.mari.mari-loft.opt.1.tooltip: 叫玛丽回来，在合唱里唱和声部。
content.dlg.mari.mari-loft.text: 芬娜派你来的！我就知道她会，我跟她说她会派人，她说不会，哈哈！我上来这儿只是为了练习高音部分，这里没人会抱怨。结果海鸥抱怨了。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-door.opt.0.label: 她为什么不肯？
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-door.opt.1.label: 去见鲁娜
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-door.opt.1.tooltip: 沿主街去铁匠铺，跟鲁娜谈谈那扇门。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-door.text: 山面包？我很乐意给你们烤一条山面包。面粉、蜂蜜、葛缕子，还有四十年的手艺，我都有。我没有的是我的烤炉门，因为铁匠鲁娜春天把它修好了，像挂鹿头一样挂在了她的锻炉上方。没有门的烤炉不过是个有野心的壁炉。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-news.opt.0.label: 面包的事
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-news.opt.0.tooltip: 告诉奥斯卡他的山面包要在哪里烤。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-news.text: 怎么？别站在门口，热气都跑出去了。出什么事了？
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-why.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-why.text: 她想让人说锻炉烤面包比烤炉强。锻炉！我们九岁那年，她在锻炉里烤过一条面包，我们拿它顶住磨坊门，省得门哐当响。要我说这话，等海干了再说。
content.dlg.runa.runa-bakes.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.runa.runa-bakes.text: 更热。更快。烤炉里一条面包要一小时，我的锻炉里只要四分钟。出来的还是面包。差不多。你拿它敲门都行。
content.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.0.label: 烤得更好？
content.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.1.label: 锻炉烤得更好
content.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.1.tooltip: 说出口。鲁娜就把炉门取下来，你把它搬回奥斯卡的烤炉上。
content.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.2.label: 就在这里烤
content.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.2.tooltip: 把山面包放进鲁娜的锻炉里烤。她保证更快。
content.dlg.runa.runa-forge.text: 来拿炉门的吧？多漂亮的炉门。我修的。我锻炉里最好的东西。只要有人承认锻炉烤面包比烤炉强，奥斯卡就能拿回去。不是他也行。谁都行。我不挑。
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.0.label: 为什么是浮标？
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.1.label: 说句台词？
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.2.label: 带上浮标
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.2.tooltip: 浮标搬到广场上，坐在第一排，桑娜对着它们说话。
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.3.label: 编成歌
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.3.tooltip: 把建城者的台词编成补网歌。她的手早就熟了。
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.text: 哦！人。脸。你好。‘我渡过寒冷的大海——’ 对不起。我是建城者。我本来每句台词都记得，但只要有人看我，我就全忘了。我怕广场。我怕两百张脸。这六个没事。它们是浮标。
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-line.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-line.text: ‘我乘着一艘不比门大的船渡过寒冷的大海，我要留下来。’ 看，没问题。现在看着我。不，看着我。没了。全没了。连门都没了。
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-why.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.sanna.sanna-why.text: 它们不眨眼。它们不会跟旁边的人说悄悄话。它们不认识我妈。我把那些脸画成观众的样子，然后全画成满意的表情。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-boat.opt.0.label: 你会唱吗？
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-boat.opt.1.label: 唱吗，斯韦雷？
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-boat.opt.1.tooltip: 按规矩，叫他的名字请他。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-boat.text: 量两次，切一次。芬娜叫你来请我唱歌。那就请吧。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-who.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-who.text: 先装龙骨，再装肋材。你问的是谁？这棚子里人不少。有我一个。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-yes.text: 叫了名字。按规矩。船壳就是这么拼起来的。我会到。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-hall.opt.0.label: 念第九条？
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-hall.opt.1.label: 我们往后挪
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-hall.opt.1.tooltip: 同意把幕布挂在舞台后面三步处，让防火通道保持畅通。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-hall.text: 我提议你说明来意。啊，幕布。我提议这是一块非常好的幕布。我还提议，挂到埃琳想挂的地方，它会挡住广场上的防火通道；第九条规章规定那通道保持四步宽。规章不是我定的。我只是爱它们。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-law.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-law.text: ‘水井到大教堂台阶之间的通道，在集会、演戏或婚礼的夜晚必须保持四步畅通，以防火灾。’ 把她的幕布往后挂三步，就没人会烧着。我很想看到它挂起来。四十年来每出戏我都看过。别告诉海达。
content.fx.opening-night.done.0.narrate: 城堡院子里的寒鸦那周孵出了四枚蛋，阿加特夫人给每一只都起了名字。
content.fx.opening-night.done.1.narrate: 团子第二年又演了尾巴，后年也演，每次都哼着演完。
content.fx.opening-night.done.10.narrate: 没人能说清传说怎么结尾。龙吃了面包吗？它到底吃过吗？镇上的人在广场上开心地争论，直到星星出来，之后一整年还在争。
content.fx.opening-night.done.2.narrate: 那六个浮标回到灯塔，坐在桑娜的窗台上，一脸满意。
content.fx.opening-night.done.3.narrate: 码头的补网人如今一边干活一边唱建城者之歌。大多数人以为它本来就是首歌。
content.fx.opening-night.done.4.narrate: 芬娜的合唱团把渡海唱成四个声部，有一个声部是在桶里唱的。
content.fx.opening-night.done.5.narrate: 芬娜独唱了渡海那段，唱得很好，之后还告诉大家她的合唱队之前在哪儿。
content.fx.opening-night.done.6.narrate: 埃琳的幕布挂在台后三步远的地方，消防通道畅通。有人看见维达尔·福斯在鼓掌。
content.fx.opening-night.done.7.narrate: 旧幕布尽了力，埃琳的新幕布仍叠在织布机上，等明年再用。
content.fx.opening-night.done.8.narrate: 整个广场再次高喊。阿加特夫人说她要每年都下山来，直到一百岁，赫达把这话记了下来。
content.fx.opening-night.done.9.narrate: 镇上的人心满意足地回家，面包吃得饱饱的，还轻声争着谁唱得最响。
content.fx.opening-night.oc.take-places.1.narrat: 太阳落到海面上。长凳坐满了人。赫达拍了拍手，喊大家就位。
content.fx.the-chorus.done.2.narrate: 街的上方某处，芬娜先唱起号子，三个声音从三个方向接了上来。
content.fx.the-curtain.done.2.narrate: 埃琳和她的两个表亲把幕布抬到广场，维达尔·福斯跟在后面步量消防通道。
content.fx.the-dragon.done.1.narrate: 阿加特夫人喊人拿外套：“贝恩特，龙要下山了。”贝恩特说龙需要条围巾。
content.fx.the-founder.done.1.narrate: 英加扶着门。“去吧。”桑娜自己一步一步走下崖边小路。
content.fx.the-loaf.oc.tell-oskar.0.narrate: 奥斯卡把自己那扇门装回自己的烤炉上，拍了两下，然后把山面包放了进去。
content.fx.the-loaf.oc.tell-oskar.1.narrate: 奥斯卡听说了山面包烘烤的地方，坐到一袋面粉上，笑得直抹眼泪。
content.fx.the-troupe.done.0.narrate: 赫达在你们身后喊道：“要是有空，酒馆的芬娜丢了合唱队，织布匠埃琳给我做了块幕布，我还没见着呢！”

source.cast.opening-night.agathe.0.bark.0: A dragon with its own tail. Imagine.
source.cast.opening-night.agathe.0.bark.1: Stand back. I'm warming up the roar.
source.cast.opening-night.agathe.1.bark.1: Stand back. I'm warming up the roar.
source.cast.opening-night.elin.0.bark.0: Nine hundred threads to the hand. I counted. Twice.
source.cast.opening-night.elin.0.bark.1: Red and gold. Wait till you see it hung.
source.cast.opening-night.oskar.0.bark.1: Same oven, same door. Same as every year.
source.cast.opening-night.oskar.1.bark.0: It's a loaf. She says. I've tapped it. It rang.
source.cast.opening-night.oskar.1.bark.1: Four minutes. I've been baking forty years.

source.cast.opening-night.runa.1.bark.1: Crust like a horseshoe. That's how you know it's done.
source.cast.opening-night.sanna.0.bark.0: Two hundred faces. I'm only going to look at the ones I need.
source.cast.opening-night.sanna.0.bark.1: I know every line. Ask me one. No, don't.
source.cast.opening-night.vidar.0.bark.0: I move that the fire lane stays clear.
source.cast.opening-night.vidar.0.bark.1: By-law nine. Four paces. Every year.
source.cast.the-chorus.oskar.0.bark.1: Same oven, same door. Same as every year.

source.cast.the-curtain.mari.1.bark.0: Top of the third verse, me. Ha!
source.cast.the-curtain.sverre.1.bark.0: Asked by name. Here I am.
source.cast.the-founder.bernt.0.bark.0: The castle is very quiet. I find I don't care for it.
source.cast.the-founder.bernt.0.bark.1: I have put the kettle on for nobody. Habit.
source.cast.the-loaf.dumpling.0.bark.0: Dumpling hums at the window and looks down at the town, where the noise is.
source.cast.the-loaf.inga.0.bark.0: She went down the path on her own feet. I watched her all the way.
source.cast.the-loaf.inga.0.bark.1: Lamp's trimmed. I'll see the play from the gallery.
source.cast.the-loaf.runa.1.bark.0: Tell Oskar the door's still warm. I polished it.
source.cast.the-loaf.sanna.0.bark.0: I'm here. I'm on the square. I haven't run away yet.
source.cast.the-loaf.sanna.0.bark.1: 'I have crossed the cold sea—' see? Easy.
source.cast.the-troupe.agathe.0.bark.0: If Hedda sent you, there's tea.
source.cast.the-troupe.agathe.0.bark.1: I am not coming down. Probably.
source.cast.the-troupe.bernt.0.bark.0: Lady Agathe is at home to callers. She is always at home to callers.
source.cast.the-troupe.bernt.0.bark.1: The ghast is not to be fed. He has been fed.

source.cast.the-troupe.fenna.1.bark.0: Haul away, haul away— where IS everybody?
source.cast.the-troupe.fenna.1.bark.1: A chorus of one is a solo. I don't do solos.
source.cast.the-troupe.inga.0.bark.0: Wind's from the sea. Good for a play.
source.cast.the-troupe.inga.0.bark.1: My niece is inside. Has been since noon.
source.cast.the-troupe.kettil.0.bark.1: Don't look while I'm hooping. Knock, knock.
source.cast.the-troupe.kettil.1.bark.1: Don't look while I'm hooping. Knock, knock.
source.cast.the-troupe.mari.0.bark.0: Up on the high bit, me. Ha!
source.cast.the-troupe.mari.0.bark.1: The gulls hate my harmony. Gulls have no taste. Ha!
source.cast.the-troupe.mari.1.bark.0: Up on the high bit, me. Ha!
source.cast.the-troupe.mari.1.bark.1: The gulls hate my harmony. Gulls have no taste. Ha!
source.cast.the-troupe.oskar.0.bark.0: Bread doesn't argue. That's why I like it.
source.cast.the-troupe.oskar.0.bark.1: Flour, honey, caraway. And a door. One day.
source.cast.the-troupe.runa.0.bark.0: Best door in Kelderby, that. I mended it.
source.cast.the-troupe.runa.0.bark.1: A forge bakes better. Ask anyone. Ask me.
source.cast.the-troupe.sanna.0.bark.0: 'I have crossed the cold sea—' no. Again.
source.cast.the-troupe.sverre.0.bark.1: A hull, a song and a supper: you build all three the same way.
source.cast.the-troupe.sverre.1.bark.1: A hull, a song and a supper: you build all three the same way.
source.cast.the-troupe.vidar.0.bark.0: I move that the fire lane stays clear.
source.cast.the-troupe.vidar.0.bark.1: By-law nine. Four paces. Every year.
source.class.lead.blurb: Takes the big part when nobody else will. Carries a feathered hat and bread for the walk.
source.class.lead.kit.0.name: Feathered Hat
source.class.lead.name: The Lead
source.class.musician.blurb: Plays the troupe on and off. Carries a horn and bread for the walk.
source.class.musician.kit.0.name: Troupe Horn
source.class.musician.name: The Musician
source.class.prompter.blurb: Knows everybody's lines, and whispers them. Carries the prompt book and bread for the walk.
source.class.prompter.kit.0.name: Prompt Book
source.class.prompter.name: The Prompter
source.class.stagehand.blurb: Moves what nobody else can lift. Carries a stage lantern and bread for the walk.
source.class.stagehand.kit.0.name: Stage Lantern
source.class.stagehand.name: The Stagehand
source.containers.decoration_notice: The barrels, crates and cupboards of the town hold their owners' goods: look all you like, but they are not yours to open.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-dumpling.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-dumpling.text: My ghast, the big white one by the ceiling. He floats about the castle and hums. He follows me everywhere, which is lovely, and into the bath, which is not. He would follow me down to the square in a heartbeat, if anyone thought to ask him.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-going.text: I am down early to frighten the children while they're fresh. Tell Hedda the Dragon has come. Tell her I said I was afraid, too. She'll like that.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-jackdaw.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-jackdaw.text: She came in through the window in March and chose the tail, because it is green and warm and full of wicker. Very sensible. She has four eggs. I have not named them yet.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-old.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-old.text: Dragons are old. That is rather the point of them. But a dragon is supposed to come down a mountain, and I am not sure my knees agree. I have been afraid of it since spring. There. I've said it, and you may tell Hedda, and she will shout.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.0.label: Too old?
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.1.label: The jackdaw?
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.2.label: Who's Dumpling?
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.3.label: Move the nest
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.3.tooltip: Carry the nest, eggs and all, to a box in the courtyard, and Lady Agathe wears the whole costume.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.4.label: Dumpling as the tail
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.opt.4.tooltip: Leave the nest where it is. Dumpling floats behind her in sailcloth, and he is the tail.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-tail.text: Hedda sent you. Of course she did. Sit, there's tea. Here is the trouble: a jackdaw has built her nest in the Dragon's tail and laid in it, and I will not turn a neighbour out of her house on the afternoon of a play. And here is the other trouble: I am seventy-eight, I am afraid I am too old to be a dragon, and I would rather not find out in front of the whole town.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-door.opt.0.label: Is she well?
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-door.opt.1.label: Take us to her.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-door.opt.1.tooltip: Ask Bernt to show you in to Lady Agathe.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-door.text: Visitors. Announced: several strangers, out of breath, at the door of Lady Agathe Holm. I am Bernt, her steward. You have come about the Dragon. Everybody has come about the Dragon.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-well.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-well.text: Perfectly well. She has decided she is too old, and a jackdaw has decided the costume is a house. I could not say which she minds more. She will tell you herself. She tells everyone everything.
source.dlg.dumpling.dumpling-hum.text: Dumpling hums at you, low and contented, and turns slowly so you can admire all of him.
source.dlg.dumpling.dumpling-tail.text: Dumpling, wrapped in sailcloth from end to end, hums at you. He has never been a tail before. He seems to think it is going well.
source.dlg.elin.elin-loom.opt.0.label: Why not?
source.dlg.elin.elin-loom.opt.1.label: We'll see Vidar.
source.dlg.elin.elin-loom.opt.1.tooltip: Go to the guildhall on the main street and talk to Vidar Foss about the curtain.
source.dlg.elin.elin-loom.text: You're the troupe? Then you can help me with the curtain. I've woven the play a new one: red, with the Dragon and the Founder's boat in gold, nine hundred threads to the hand. I want it hung on the square tonight. Vidar Foss at the guildhall says I can't.
source.dlg.elin.elin-news.opt.0.label: He was right.
source.dlg.elin.elin-news.opt.0.tooltip: Tell Elin to hang it three paces back from the stage, and the fire lane stays clear.
source.dlg.elin.elin-news.text: Well? Did he say no again? He says no beautifully.
source.dlg.elin.elin-why.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.elin.elin-why.text: He says it blocks a fire lane. He says a lot of things. He's usually right, which is the worst thing about him.
source.dlg.fenna.fenna-chorus.opt.0.label: Where are they?
source.dlg.fenna.fenna-chorus.opt.1.label: We'll find them.
source.dlg.fenna.fenna-chorus.opt.1.tooltip: Find Kettil, Mari and Sverre and bring them back to the chorus.
source.dlg.fenna.fenna-chorus.text: Haul away, haul away— oh, hello. I lead the shanty chorus for the sea crossing in the play, and my chorus has gone. Kettil is our cooper, Mari keeps the net loft, and Sverre is the boatwright: three voices, all somewhere in town, none of them here.
source.dlg.fenna.fenna-where.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.fenna.fenna-where.text: Kettil's at his cooperage, lower down the main street. He sings, but only where nobody can see him. Mari's at the net loft near the bottom of the street; she's the high notes. Sverre's at the boatwright's shed along the side lane. He'll sing if you ask him properly. By name. He's very particular.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-agathe.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-agathe.text: She has played the Dragon for thirty years. She is my oldest friend and she roars like a landslide. If she says she won't come down, there's a reason, and it won't be the one she sent.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.opt.0.label: About Lady Agathe?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.opt.1.label: About Sanna?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.opt.2.label: Oskar and Runa?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.opt.3.label: Back to work.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-errands.text: Still here? The sun isn't waiting. The Dragon is up at the castle, the Founder is out at the lighthouse, and the Loaf is somewhere between the bakery and the smithy. I'll hold the square.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-legend.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-legend.text: The founding of Kelderby. A fisherwoman, the Founder, sails into the bay. A Dragon on the mountain says she may stay if she brings it one loaf a year. She bakes the first Mountain Loaf, the Dragon eats it and becomes the town's friend, and everyone goes to the tavern. The tavern isn't in the play. It's still true.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-loaf.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-loaf.text: They have been arguing since they were nine. Runa mended Oskar's oven door, and now she won't give it back until he admits something he will never admit. Bread is involved. Mostly it's pride.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-missing.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-missing.text: The Dragon is up at the castle, at the top of the long road from this square. The lighthouse is out on the headland: down the main street, along the lane near the bottom, then the cliff path. The bakery is just below the square, and the smithy is halfway down the main street, under the anvil sign.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-not-troupe.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-not-troupe.text: Of course you're the troupe. You walked onto my square on the right afternoon with nothing to do. That is what a troupe is. Now, are you going to stand there, or are you going to help?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-not-yet.text: Then go and get them! I will hold the sun. I won't, but I will glare at it.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-places.opt.0.label: Curtain up!
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-places.opt.1.label: Not yet.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-places.text: Places! Places, everyone. The benches are filling and the sun is going down. The moment I have a Dragon, a Founder and a Loaf on this square, the curtain goes up. Have I?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-sanna.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-sanna.text: Sanna mends nets on the quay and knows every line of the Founder. She says them perfectly to the gulls. Faces are another matter.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.0.label: We're not a troupe.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.1.label: What's the play?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.2.label: Where do we go?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.3.label: We'll do it.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.opt.3.tooltip: Leave it to us: a Dragon, a Founder and a Loaf, by sunset.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-welcome.text: There you are: the troupe! Hedda Brask. I keep The Bell, and every year I direct the Founders' Play, here on the square, at sunset. Which is today. We have a stage. We do not have a Dragon, a Founder or a Loaf. Lady Agathe won't come down from the castle. Sanna, the net-mender, has run off to her aunt's lighthouse. And Oskar, the baker, can't bake, because Runa, the smith, has his oven door.
source.dlg.hedda.play-curtain-call.opt.0.label: Take a bow.
source.dlg.hedda.play-curtain-call.opt.0.toolti: Step out in front of the whole town and bow.
source.dlg.hedda.play-curtain-call.text: Hedda walks to the front of the stage and speaks to the benches, and to you. 'Kelderby, I have a confession. The troupe I hired never came. These are not actors. I knew it the moment they walked onto my square, and I said nothing, because they said yes. Give them a hand.'
source.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-dumpling.text: Lady Agathe sweeps on, and behind her, wrapped in sailcloth, Dumpling floats in as the tail. The children in the front row scream with joy. Lady Agathe roars, and Dumpling, who has never heard her roar, hums louder.
source.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-nest.opt.0.label: On with the play.
source.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-nest.text: Lady Agathe sweeps on in the whole costume, tail and all, and roars like a landslide. Up in the castle courtyard, in the box you nailed up, a jackdaw sleeps through it.
source.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-roar.opt.0.label: On with the play.
source.dlg.hedda.play-dragon-roar.text: You roar from the wings. Lady Agathe turns and roars back at you, twice as loud, and the square applauds the contest before the Dragon remembers the play.
source.dlg.hedda.play-dragon.opt.0.label: Cue the Dragon
source.dlg.hedda.play-dragon.opt.1.label: Cue the Dragon
source.dlg.hedda.play-dragon.opt.2.label: Roar from the wings
source.dlg.hedda.play-dragon.text: Thunder on a sheet of tin. The lanterns along the stage flicker. The Dragon comes down from the mountain.
source.dlg.hedda.play-founder-buoys.opt.0.label: On with the play.
source.dlg.hedda.play-founder-buoys.text: Sanna finds the front row: six painted buoys, grinning on a bench. She talks to them, and she talks to them so well that the square forgets she ever stopped. 'I have crossed the cold sea,' she tells the buoys, 'and I mean to stay.'
source.dlg.hedda.play-founder-song.opt.0.label: On with the play.
source.dlg.hedda.play-founder-song.text: Sanna's hands start mending a net that isn't there, and the speech comes out as the work-song every net-mender on the quay knows. By the second verse the fishwives on the benches are singing it with her.
source.dlg.hedda.play-founder-whisper.text: You whisper the line from the wings. Sanna says it after you, loud and clear, and then the next one without you. 'I have crossed the cold sea, and I mean to stay.'
source.dlg.hedda.play-founder.opt.0.label: Point at the buoys
source.dlg.hedda.play-founder.opt.1.label: Hum the work-song
source.dlg.hedda.play-founder.opt.2.label: Whisper her line
source.dlg.hedda.play-founder.text: The curtain goes up on a painted sea. Sanna steps out as the Founder, opens her mouth, sees two hundred faces, and stops. The whole square waits. She looks at you.
source.dlg.hedda.play-loaf-forge.opt.0.label: The curtain call
source.dlg.hedda.play-loaf-forge.text: Runa carries the Mountain Loaf on, black as a horseshoe and twice as heavy. The Dragon bites. The Dragon's teeth do not. Lady Agathe tries again from the side. Somebody in the third row laughs, then everybody, and the play stops right there, one scene short of its end.
source.dlg.hedda.play-loaf-oven.opt.0.label: The curtain call
source.dlg.hedda.play-loaf-oven.text: Oskar carries the Mountain Loaf on in both arms, golden from his own oven with its own door. The Dragon takes one bite, then another, and then, against every rehearsal, the whole loaf. 'Friends,' says the Dragon, with its mouth full. That is the end of the play.
source.dlg.hedda.play-loaf.opt.0.label: Serve the Loaf
source.dlg.hedda.play-loaf.opt.1.label: Serve the Loaf
source.dlg.hedda.play-loaf.text: 'Bring me my loaf!' roars the Dragon. The Founder turns to the wings, and the baker comes on with the Mountain Loaf.
source.dlg.inga.inga-buoys.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.inga.inga-buoys.text: Six of them, with faces painted on. She says she can say her lines to anything that doesn't look back. She's right. I've heard her. Word perfect.
source.dlg.inga.inga-door.opt.0.label: Buoys?
source.dlg.inga.inga-door.opt.1.label: Can we see her?
source.dlg.inga.inga-door.text: You'll be from Hedda. Sanna's in here with me. Been here since noon, talking to buoys.
source.dlg.inga.inga-go-on.text: Go on. Gently. She's braver than she thinks. Don't tell her I said so.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-cooper.opt.0.label: Close your eyes?
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-cooper.opt.1.label: Sing in a barrel
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-cooper.opt.1.tooltip: Sing from inside a barrel at the back of the stage, where nobody can see you.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-cooper.text: Knock, knock. Fenna sent you. I'll sing. I can't sing if anyone's looking at me. I've tried. My voice goes into my boots. Knock, knock.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-eyes.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-eyes.text: Then I can't see them, but they can still see me. That's the half that matters. Knock, knock.
source.dlg.mari.mari-high.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.mari.mari-high.text: Top of the third verse. Nobody else can reach it. Kettil tried once and his cat left home. Ha!
source.dlg.mari.mari-loft.opt.0.label: The high bit?
source.dlg.mari.mari-loft.opt.1.label: Come and sing
source.dlg.mari.mari-loft.opt.1.tooltip: Ask Mari to come back and sing the harmony in the chorus.
source.dlg.mari.mari-loft.text: Fenna sent you! I knew she would, I told her she'd send someone, she said she wouldn't, ha! I only came up here to practise the high bit where nobody would complain. The gulls complained.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-door.opt.0.label: Why won't she?
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-door.opt.1.label: We'll see Runa.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-door.opt.1.tooltip: Go down the main street to the smithy and talk to Runa about the door.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-door.text: A Mountain Loaf? I'd love to bake you a Mountain Loaf. I have the flour, the honey, the caraway and forty years. What I don't have is my oven door, because Runa the smith mended it in spring and hung it over her forge like a stag's head. An oven without a door is a fireplace with ambitions.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-news.opt.0.label: About the Loaf.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-news.opt.0.tooltip: Tell Oskar where his Mountain Loaf is going to be baked.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-news.text: Well? Don't stand in the door letting the heat out. What's happened?
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-why.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-why.text: She wants somebody to say a forge bakes better than an oven. A forge! She baked a loaf in hers once, when we were nine. We used it to stop the mill door banging. I'll say it when the sea is dry.
source.dlg.runa.runa-bakes.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.runa.runa-bakes.text: Hotter. Faster. A loaf in an oven takes an hour. A loaf in my forge takes four minutes. What comes out is a loaf. Mostly. You can knock with it.
source.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.0.label: Bakes better?
source.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.1.label: A forge bakes better
source.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.1.tooltip: Say it. Runa takes the door down, and you carry it back to Oskar's oven.
source.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.2.label: Bake it here
source.dlg.runa.runa-forge.opt.2.tooltip: Bake the Mountain Loaf in Runa's forge. She swears it's quicker.
source.dlg.runa.runa-forge.text: Come for the door, have you? Beautiful door. I mended it. Best thing in my forge. Oskar can have it back the moment somebody admits that a forge bakes better than an oven. Not him, even. Anybody. I'm not proud.
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.0.label: Why buoys?
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.1.label: Say a line?
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.2.label: Bring the buoys
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.2.tooltip: The buoys go down to the square and sit in the front row, and Sanna speaks to them.
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.3.label: Make it a song
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.opt.3.tooltip: Turn the Founder's speeches into the net-mending song. Her hands know it already.
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-buoys.text: Oh! People. Faces. Hello. 'I have crossed the cold sea—' sorry. I'm the Founder. I know every line right up until somebody looks at me, and then I know nothing at all. I'm frightened of the square. I'm frightened of two hundred faces. These six are fine. They're buoys.
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-line.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-line.text: 'I have crossed the cold sea in a boat no bigger than a door, and I mean to stay.' See? Fine. Now look at me. No, look at me. Gone. All of it. Even the door.
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-why.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.sanna.sanna-why.text: They don't blink. They don't whisper to the person next to them. They don't know my mother. I painted the faces so they'd feel like an audience, and then I made them all look pleased.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-boat.opt.0.label: Will you sing?
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-boat.opt.1.label: Sing, Sverre?
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-boat.opt.1.tooltip: Ask him properly, by his name.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-boat.text: Measure twice, cut once. Fenna sent you to ask me to sing. Then ask.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-who.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-who.text: Keel first, then the ribs. Who are you asking? There's a lot of people in this shed. There's me.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-yes.text: Asked by name. Properly. That's how a hull holds together. I'll be there.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-hall.opt.0.label: Read by-law nine?
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-hall.opt.1.label: We'll move it back.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-hall.opt.1.tooltip: Agree to hang the curtain three paces back from the stage, so the fire lane stays clear.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-hall.text: I move that you state your business. Ah, the curtain. I move that it is a very fine curtain. I also move that, hung where Elin wants it, it blocks the fire lane on the square, which by-law nine keeps four paces wide. I don't make the by-laws. I only love them.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-law.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-law.text: 'The way from the well to the cathedral steps shall be kept four paces clear on the night of any assembly, play or wedding, against fire.' Hang her curtain three paces back and nobody burns. I'd love to see it hung. I've seen every play for forty years. Don't tell Hedda.
source.fx.opening-night.done.0.narrate: The jackdaw in the castle courtyard hatched four eggs that week, and Lady Agathe named every one.
source.fx.opening-night.done.1.narrate: Dumpling played the tail again the next year, and the year after, and hummed through every one.
source.fx.opening-night.done.10.narrate: Nobody can agree how the legend ends. Does the Dragon eat the loaf? Did it ever? The town argues happily on the square until the stars come out, and all the next year.
source.fx.opening-night.done.2.narrate: The six buoys went back to the lighthouse and sat on Sanna's windowsill, looking pleased.
source.fx.opening-night.done.3.narrate: The net-menders on the quay sing the Founder's song now while they work. Most of them think it was always a song.
source.fx.opening-night.done.4.narrate: Fenna's chorus sang the sea crossing in four parts, one of them from inside a barrel.
source.fx.opening-night.done.5.narrate: Fenna sang the sea crossing on her own, and very well, and told everyone afterwards where her chorus had been.
source.fx.opening-night.done.6.narrate: Elin's curtain hung three paces back from the stage, and the fire lane stayed clear. Vidar Foss was seen clapping.
source.fx.opening-night.done.7.narrate: The old curtain did its best, and Elin's new one stayed folded on her loom for next year.
source.fx.opening-night.done.8.narrate: The whole square shouts for it again. Lady Agathe says she will come down every year until she is a hundred, and Hedda writes it down.
source.fx.opening-night.done.9.narrate: The town goes home pleased, full of loaf, arguing gently about who sang loudest.
source.fx.opening-night.oc.take-places.1.narrat: The sun touches the sea. The benches fill. Hedda claps her hands for places.
source.fx.the-chorus.done.2.narrate: Somewhere up the street, Fenna starts the shanty, and three voices answer her from three directions.
source.fx.the-curtain.done.2.narrate: Elin and two of her cousins carry the curtain up to the square, and Vidar Foss paces out the fire lane behind them.
source.fx.the-dragon.done.1.narrate: Lady Agathe calls for her coat. 'Bernt, the Dragon is going down the mountain.' Bernt says the Dragon will need a scarf.
source.fx.the-founder.done.1.narrate: Inga holds the door. 'Go on, then.' Sanna goes down the cliff path on her own feet.
source.fx.the-loaf.oc.tell-oskar.0.narrate: Oskar hangs his own door back on his own oven, pats it twice, and the Mountain Loaf goes in.
source.fx.the-loaf.oc.tell-oskar.1.narrate: Oskar hears where his Mountain Loaf is baking, sits down on a sack of flour, and laughs until he has to wipe his eyes.
source.fx.the-troupe.done.0.narrate: Hedda calls after you: 'And if you have time, Fenna at the tavern has lost her chorus, and Elin the weaver has made me a curtain I still haven't seen!'

source.obj.the-dragon.climb-to-the-castle.title: Climb to the castle

source.obj.the-troupe.meet-hedda.title: Speak to the innkeeper
source.quest.opening-night.goal: Put on the Founders' Play at sunset.
source.quest.the-chorus.goal: Gather the tavern's scattered shanty chorus.
source.quest.the-curtain.goal: Get the weaver's new curtain hung on the square, by-law and all.
source.quest.the-dragon.goal: Climb the castle road and bring the town its Dragon.
source.quest.the-founder.goal: Go out to the lighthouse and bring the town its Founder.
source.quest.the-loaf.goal: Settle the oven door between the baker and the smith, and bring the town its Loaf.
source.quest.the-troupe.goal: Be taken for the travelling troupe and hear what the play is missing.
